about: Audio conditions for the phone-robustness evaluation; implemented in src/voice_agent/degrade.py. Noise is added at the caller's side, before the channel.

conditions.tel: 300-3400 Hz band-pass, 8 kHz, G.711 mu-law, back to 16 kHz
conditions.tel+opus8: tel, then Opus at 8 kbit/s narrowband (stand-in for a low-bitrate mobile codec; no GSM/AMR encoder available)
conditions.tel+babble15: babble from 6 FLEURS speakers outside the evaluation slice at 15 dB SNR, then tel
conditions.tel+babble5: babble at 5 dB SNR, then tel
conditions.tel+white10: white noise at 10 dB SNR, then tel
conditions.tel+loss5: tel, then 5 % of 20 ms frames zeroed (packet loss without concealment)
